scope: 88 seen baseline games. Only full-scan cards appearing in affordable main-action card candidates are included; missing, unaffordable and unsupported cards are excluded. Instances are deduplicated within each seat/game and matched to explicit play/discard/movement decisions. These are opportunity counts, not mistakes or causal efficiency estimates. First 24 use source-fixed runtime, remaining 64 retain original scoring/runtime reports.
